response.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.fundflux, '__MISSING__') AS fund, COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS n FROM scanqc q JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = q.arcref GROUP BY COALESCE(p.fundflux, '__MISSING__')) SELECT CASE WHEN fund = '__MISSING__' THEN NULL ELSE fund END AS fundflux, n AS project_count, n * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(n) FROM m) AS fraction_of_total, n * 1.0 / (SELECT AVG(n * 1.0) FROM m) AS ratio_to_average FROM m
